title: Custom themes for Claude Code Desktop
summary: Describe the look. Claude Code Desktop builds the theme, backdrop and all.

assets.excerpt: A frame at 0:24 of the post video

prompts.text: Make me a Claude Code Desktop theme with a synthwave sunset and neon pink accents, as a mod that follows https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview. Write it in a new folder inside the current project folder, and ask me before you install or load anything.
prompts.label: Synthwave sunset and neon pink

action.label: Make a Claude Code theme in Atu

made.alt: Hey Atu writes three theme files. A coding workspace lights up with a striped gold and pink sunset, glowing mountains, stars, a moving perspective grid and neon pink chat controls.
made.caption: Mockup: a synthwave theme for Claude Code Desktop, made with Hey Atu
